# AI Acceptable Use Policy (v2.0)

## 1. Purpose
This policy sets the rules for using generative AI tools at work. It applies to all employees, contractors, and interns.

## 2. Precedence
This policy and the standards it references (the Approved AI Tools list and the AI Data Handling Standard) are the source of truth. If an FAQ, a Slack thread, or a team guide says something different, this policy wins.

## 3. Core rules
3.1 Use only tools on the **Approved AI Tools** list (`approved-ai-tools.md`), and only for the uses listed there.
3.2 Classify data before you share it with any AI tool. See the **Data Classification Policy** (`data-classification.md`).
3.3 Follow the **AI Data Handling Standard** (`ai-data-handling-standard.md`) for which data classes may go into which tools.
3.4 Never use a personal AI account (free or paid) for company work.
3.5 You are responsible for reviewing AI output before you share it with clients.

## 4. Getting access
To request access to an approved tool, see Section 4 of the Approved AI Tools list.

## 5. Exceptions
Exceptions must be requested in writing from the AI Task Force and, for Restricted data, approved by the Data Protection Officer. See Appendix B for the exception form.

## 6. Contacts
- Policy questions: AI Task Force, ai-taskforce@company.example, Slack #ai-taskforce
- Data and privacy questions: Privacy Office, privacy@company.example
